nail_bed_anchor.meaning: cuticle centre of the natural nail, normalised to the canvas; identical in all four files

bottom_edge: finger is cropped flat at the canvas bottom (enters from below)

main_nail_on_finger.placement: nail cell anchor (0.5,0.925) on nail_bed_anchor; nail width = 1.08x natural plate (~130 px)
main_nail_on_finger.overflow: nail tip extends ~70 px above the finger canvas top at this scale; container must not clip (overflow: visible)
